description: A React-like (Qwik) component implementing a modal dialog for posting new job listings, with form state management, validation, and event handling.

classes.name: FormState
classes.description: Interface defining the shape of the form state for the job posting modal.

classes.name: Props
classes.description: Interface defining the properties accepted by the NewJobModal component.

methods.name: resetAndClose
methods.description: Function to reset form and error state, then invoke onClose$ event.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Function to validate form data and, if valid, invoke onSubmit$ callback and close modal.
